developer-letter.name: A Letter from the Developer
developer-letter.heading: A Thank-You Letter to BSV Players
developer-letter.body:
I wonder whether BSV has helped you make some wonderful memories during your year in Pelican Town. Has it genuinely made your game a little better along the way?

If it has, that is exactly why I created BSV.

If it hasn't, I'm sorry to hear that. But I'd love to hear your thoughts. Perhaps you could leave a suggestion in the comments and let me know what could be improved.

Either way, thank you so much for downloading and playing BSV, and for letting this little mod become part of your life in Pelican Town.

Oh! To celebrate your year in Pelican Town, I've also prepared a precious bottle of Blood of Jesus. Please accept it as a little gift from me!

Finally, I wish you all the best in your life in Pelican Town!

Your most handsome mod developer,

— EddieF

rescue.native-handoff: Waiting for the normal recovery sequence… BSV controls released.
config.waiting-host: Waiting for the host policy. Extra shared rewards and grants are paused.
config.legacy: A legacy value is preserved unless you explicitly select a replacement.
config.machines-unavailable: Integrated machines are not ready; their files will not be overwritten.
config.seed-enabled.help: Host setting. Only BSV bonus seeds are affected; applies on the next harvest. New-install/reset default: off.
config.seed-chance.help: Host setting. Used only when seed return is enabled; 0–100%, step 5%.
config.yield-enabled.help: Host setting. Disable only BSV extra yield; native harvest and quality remain unchanged.
config.fertilizer-enabled.help: Host setting; next successful harvest. On selects the quality fertilizer tier’s final yield chances; off keeps the generic Extra Harvest chances. Native quality, seed return and both fertilizer slots remain independent. Both slots work even when both BSV enhancements are off.
config.fish-days.help: Host setting. 1–4 calendar days (1440 minutes/day); next batch only. Paid batches retain their due time.
config.crab-days.help: Host setting. 1–4 calendar days (1440 minutes/day); next batch only. No bait, quality or critical changes.
config.auto-restart.help: Host setting. On restarts when internal bait and other requirements are met, even with stored output. Off finishes the current cycle only. Supply bait and explicitly close the machine menu to start one cycle manually. Cycle duration follows the configured value.
config.afk-enabled.help: Personal setting. Off safely stops automatic actions; committed catches are retained. Enabling does not start AFK automatically.
config.afk-threshold.help: Personal setting. Current/max stamina ratio; 5–50%, step 5%. Existing pre-cast safety checks remain.
config.afk-return: Return to Fishing Spot Next Day
config.afk-return.help: Personal setting. Off preserves the fishing spot and catches, but stops automatic return after rest or at the next safe travel boundary.
config.afk-chests.help: Personal setting. Controls all AFK chest deposits, bait and food withdrawals. Range stays player-centred 3×3.
config.professions.help: Host setting; saved changes apply during play. Turning off retains existing professions and health. Turning on fills eligible missing professions.
config.annual-fish.help: Host setting; next save load. Off restores original lifetime limits, preserving catch history. Spirit Fish keeps its own annual limit.
config.horse-enabled.help: Host setting. Only BSV speed contribution is affected; summoning and ownership are unchanged.
config.horse-speed.help: Host setting. 0–50% extra speed, step 5%; next speed calculation. Off preserves this chosen value.
config.orders-enabled.help: Host setting. Off stops new orders and transactions. Existing data, committed rewards, recovery and payments are retained.
orders.disabled: BSV Orders is disabled by the host. Existing contracts and committed payments are preserved.
machine.pause.owner: The machine's owner is unavailable. Check the SMAPI log; the paid batch is preserved.
machine.pause.moved: The machine's position no longer matches its recorded environment. Check the SMAPI log; do not delete the pending batch.
machine.pause.quota: Waiting for capture quota settlement. The paid opportunity is preserved.
machine.pause.manual-catch: Waiting for the owner's manual catch to finish before settling the legendary-fish quota.
machine.pause.ecology: No supported crab-pot species are available here. Check this location's fish data and the SMAPI log; the batch is preserved.
machine.pause.geometry: The machine's water placement is no longer valid. Check its surroundings and the SMAPI log; the batch is preserved.
machine.pause.history: The recorded environment or time history cannot be used safely. Check the SMAPI log; do not delete the preserved batch or history.
machine.pause.ledger: The timeline or quota record could not be read safely. Check the SMAPI log; do not reset or delete the preserved records.
machine.pause.unknown: Production stopped safely. Check the SMAPI log for details; do not delete pending production data.
diag.greenhouse-conflict: BSV could not expand this greenhouse map. Disable other greenhouse map replacements before using BSV's expanded greenhouse.
diag.greenhouse-foreign: Another mod replaces the greenhouse map. BSV leaves it unchanged. If you use that map on purpose, turn off "Expand the greenhouse" in BSV settings to hide this message.
diag.cellar-foreign: Another mod replaces the cellar map. BSV leaves it unchanged. If you use that map on purpose, turn off "Expand the cellar" in BSV settings to hide this message.
diag.machine.standalone-conflict: BSV detected standalone Eddie.FishingMachine. The integrated machine is skipped to prevent duplicate processing. Remove the standalone mod and restart to use BSV's integrated version.
cmd.sewer-usage: Usage: bsv_sewer_status [anchorX anchorY]. Omit both coordinates to inspect the tile under the mouse.
diag.developer-letter-disabled: The developer's thank-you letter is disabled because initialization failed. Other modules remain available; check the technical details below.
diag.sewer-error: Sewer diagnostics failed; no game state was changed. Check the technical details below.
afk.recovery-stopped: AFK recovery timed out and stopped. Pending catches are preserved; control is yours.
status.auto-off: Automatic restart is off. Start manually to run one cycle.
panel.take-full: Backpack full. The rest stays in the machine.
panel.auto-upgrade: Upgrades automatically when the cycles and materials are ready.
panel.take-help: Moves the catch into your backpack. Bait and upgrade materials stay in the machine.
professions.ui.pending: Required level reached. Check pending upgrades or the all-professions setting.
config.speedgro-enabled.help: Host setting; next regrowth cycle only. Enhances regrowth using the original crop interval. Native first-growth acceleration and Agriculturist remain unchanged. Current growth timers stay fixed; dual fertilizers remain active even when both enhancements are off.
farming.rejected: Fertilizer could not be applied. No material is lost; any pending refund waits for inventory space.
farming.version: Farming transactions require the host and client to use the same BSV version.
machine.stage-unknown: Old stage history is incomplete; upgrade paused. Materials: {{materials}}. See the SMAPI log.
config.fish-days1.help: Host setting. 1–4 calendar days (1440 minutes/day); next batch only. Paid batches retain their due time.
config.fish-days2.help: Host setting. 1–4 calendar days (1440 minutes/day); next batch only. Paid batches retain their due time.
config.fish-days3.help: Host setting. 1–4 calendar days (1440 minutes/day); next batch only. Paid batches retain their due time.
config.crab-days1.help: Host setting. 1–4 calendar days (1440 minutes/day); next batch only. No bait, quality or critical changes.
config.crab-days2.help: Host setting. 1–4 calendar days (1440 minutes/day); next batch only. No bait, quality or critical changes.
machine.no-trash: Lv2+ produces no trash. Algae and jelly remain eligible. Existing stored items are preserved.
horse.call.cross_map_unavailable: Cross-map recall is unavailable: approach your horse on the same map.
horse.call.withdrawal_unavailable: The horse has left the viewing area. It remains in the world; safe entity withdrawal is not available in this build.
